flop <command> [arguments]
Find a FLOP devnet tool and run its own CLI.

Suite commands
  help [command]          Show suite help or a tool's options
  list [--json]           List registered suite commands
  which <words> [--json]  Search names, summaries and question taglines
  completions <shell>    Print bash, zsh or fish completion script

observe
  community   Inspect dated public requests, response times and access-form fields
  explore     Search devnet entities and inspect dated query evidence
  finality    Measure linked block times and compare reported finality lag with pinned rules
  history     Record devnet snapshots and compare reset signals and claim changes
  models      Join model listings, registry hashes and dated price sources
  sessions    Classify compute channel lifecycle states with dated evidence
  status      Probe public service responses and inspect measured availability
  upgrades    Compare dated spec revisions and observe package release history

verify
  contracts   Audit advertised MCP schemas and inspect dated trust material
  economics   Model exact emission and compare dated settlement fees with the paper
  harness     Check documented network claims against public responses
  indexer     Audit indexer totals, block links and settlement accounting
  invariants  Map quoted security rules to scoped checks and public evidence gaps
  metering    Calculate reference-work units and inspect dated calibration lease evidence
  proofs      Inspect proof submissions and explain settlement coverage limits
  spec        Compare the pinned yellowpaper with dated public observations
  verify      Cross-check settlements, receipts and attestation evidence offline

build
  action      Run bounded CI evidence checks with dated reports and job summaries
  api         Read dated suite results and generate their OpenAPI contract
  call        Call read-only MCP tools and compare dated devnet cost estimates
  export      Export dated devnet rows with hashes and resumable parts
  knowledge   Browse catalog relationships, cited requirements and agent-pack responses
  sdk         Check published SDK behaviour with offline request traces
  spec-read   Read pinned sections, terms and parameters beside dated catalog evidence
  start       Generate a devnet-only agent with fixture-backed dry runs
  x402        Diagnose pay-per-call payment headers

operate
  doctor      Check local operator readiness against sourced requirements
  stake       Model quoted stake requirements and inspect indexed stake evidence
  watch       Watch dated network changes with persisted rules and bounded delivery

agents
  challenge   Find settlements that need a challenge-window review
  guard       Evaluate an agent's spend against a budget policy
  mcp         Serve read-only suite tools over schema-checked stdio MCP
  score       Rank miners by observed settlement evidence
  swap        Plan HTLC timing, generate local hash locks and inspect dated swaps
  tclk        Inspect signed agent deals against the pinned TCLK protocol

identity
  did         Follow signed artifacts and verify their exact bytes

Examples: flop help verify | flop which miner reliability | flop list --json
Put --json last. JSON-native operations accept it through the wrapper. Child exit codes are preserved.
Suite exits: 0 success, 1 no search match, 2 usage or missing installation.
